data.name: Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero
data.detailed_description:
Content Creation & Streaming Policy

We grant permission for individuals to record, stream, and monetize gameplay footage of "Last Hammashan" on platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Facebook Gaming, and similar services.

Last Hammashan is being developed by a solo programmer and on Zero budget.

To save the people of his village, He enters the Hammashan castle from which no one returns alive. But he sparks a war for the power of a civilization which the world believed has been annihilated.

To force Gideon into entering the Hammashan castle to retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Astrolabe, Greystone takes the people of his village hostages. The Astrolabe was left behind in the castle by the Hammashan civilization. It is the key to their ancient knowledge.

When Gideon touches the Astrolabe, it activates and shows him a place unfamiliar to him. He hears a voice calling out: "Come home Adam!" Gideon discovers that his real name is Adam and that he is the last Hammashan. An entity at the site awakens his Hammashan blood which alerts the tyrant Sevarog who calls upon his generals and orders killing Adam.

What is different?

  • Whenever Adam (Gideon) defeats any of Sevarog’s 12 generals, he reclaims the Hammashan powers from them and then he wields it, as well as the fighting style, as his own. Every win means new abilities and a new fighting style.

  • Adam doesn't die, the lesser health he has, the more vulnerable he is. example: when his health is low, even small hits make him kneel for a long time.

Example from the gameplay video:

In the boss fight video, Adam has already defeated Twinblast and so he reclaimed the Hammashan powers from him and he can wield it as his own. When transformed, Adam moves and fights exactly like Twinblast. That is, he doesn’t just reclaim weapons and powers, he reclaims the fighting style. Adam can also instantly switch between his original powers and transformed powers. At the end of the video, Greystone tries to use his ultimate attack at the same moment Adam reclaims the Hammashan power from him which leaves Greystone frozen as a statue. Adam reclaims the Hammashan sword fighting style and wields it as his own. He uses it to finish Greystone saying to him: grey stone, what a befitting end.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 1030 4GB, Radeon RX 550 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7-10750H or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070, Radeon RX 5700 XT or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
